```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```


```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the SMARVUS dataset
data_file <- "smarvus_complete_050524.csv"

# Download dataset only if it is not already saved
if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  smarvus_raw <- read_csv("https://osf.io/download/a4zmv/")
  write_csv(smarvus_raw, data_file)
} else {
  smarvus_raw <- read_csv(data_file)
}
```

```{r, data cleaning - emma c, echo=FALSE}
# Number of participants and variables
dim(smarvus_raw)

# Check duplicate rows
sum(duplicated(smarvus_raw))

# Check total missing values
sum(is.na(smarvus_raw))
```



```{r, missing data echo=FALSE}
# missing values for each variable

missing_summary <- smarvus_raw %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~sum(is.na(.))
                   )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Missing") %>%
  arrange(desc(Missing))

head(missing_summary, 15)

```
RMARS is revised mathematics anxiety rating scale (NORMAL MATHS ANXIETY ONE)
RMARS-S is like RMARS but replaces the maths with stats
STARS is statistics anxiety rating scale (NORMAL STATS ANXIETY ONE)
STARS-M is a modified version of STARS but replaces the stats with maths
